about.text: A mild yoghurt culture and product name from Germany, introduced in 1956: Streptococcus thermophilus with Lactobacillus acidophilus in place of the sharper Lactobacillus bulgaricus, so the yoghurt sours less. Its sister culture Biogarde adds bifidobacteria.

how.text: Leaving out L. bulgaricus and using gentler-acidifying lactobacilli gives a yoghurt that is only mildly sour. Bioghurt was introduced in the 1950s as a German sour-milk speciality.
